+def _quota_intervals(data):
+    k = data["k"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"] if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    n = len(jobs)
+    for mask in range(1 << n):
+        if mask.bit_count() != k:
+            continue
+        chosen = [jobs[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1]
+        ids = {job["id"] for job in chosen}
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in chosen:
+            group = job["group"]
+            counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in data.get("quotas", {}).items()):
+            continue
+        active_ends = []
+        compatible = True
+        for job in sorted(chosen, key=lambda j: (j["start"], j["end"], j["id"])):
+            active_ends = [end for end in active_ends if end > job["start"]]
+            if len(active_ends) >= 2:
+                compatible = False
+                break
+            active_ends.append(job["end"])
+        if not compatible:
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in chosen)
+        sorted_ids = sorted(ids)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and sorted_ids > best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, sorted_ids
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
